baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction بوأنا ... مكان البيت joins prepared emplacement to the commands not to associate anything and to purify My House.
baseline_models.mechanism: Abraham is installed at a deliberately prepared dwelling-place whose divine claim is undivided and whose condition is maintained for worshippers. Place, ownership, cleansing, and use form one commissioning mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Prepared lodging supplies the act of making the sacred location inhabitable and usable.
Place and established position give the commission a fixed spatial center.
Shelter and dwelling make the House a receiving habitat rather than an abstract marker.
Refusal of a divine partner establishes the House's undivided Godward dedication.
Removal of defilement supplies the continuing condition that makes the dedicated dwelling fit for use.

changed_reading.before: God identifies a site and separately orders Abraham to keep a sanctuary clean.
changed_reading.after: God commissions Abraham to establish an inhabitable, exclusively God-claimed center and keep it fit for its worshipping users.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The beneficiary list moves from الطائفين through القائمين to الركع السجود.
baseline_models.mechanism: The listed bodies organize a cleared field: circulation uses the perimeter, standing establishes an upright station, and bowing and prostration lower the body toward the ground. The list can therefore be read as spatial choreography as well as classes of worshippers.

activation_trace.role: Clearing defilement supplies an unobstructed field for the following bodily actions.
Circling supplies movement around a stable center.
Bodily uprightness supplies the stationary vertical phase.
Bending and lowering the head begin the descent from uprightness.
Full lowering and submission complete the movement toward the ground.

changed_reading.before: Purification prepares a static building for several named worshipper groups.
changed_reading.after: Purification clears a coordinated movement field extending from circuit, through upright station, to successive lowering.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: القائمين stands between circling and bending worshippers but its root inventory also carries care, preservation, and keeping an affair upright.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside the dominant postural reading, the standers may faintly include those who keep watch over, tend, or sustain the House's ordered use. The neighboring posture nouns constrain this to a secondary institutional activation.

activation_trace.role: Preparing a lodging implies an ongoing usable establishment, not only locating coordinates.
A dwelling supplies the institution whose hospitable condition must be sustained.
Care, preservation, and charge activate a custodial shade within the surface sense of standing.
Keeping the House free of defilement supplies the custodian's functional task.

changed_reading.before: The standers are only bodies occupying one prayer posture.
changed_reading.after: The standers may also carry a restrained echo of people who keep the House and its worship operational.

context_deltas.mechanism: Worship on an edge that reverses under trial supplies a spatial and affective anti-model to the focus's fixed place, centered circuit, and upright station. The House becomes a discipline of reorientation around a center rather than conditional balance at a margin.

activation_trace.role: A fixed place supplies the center against which marginal worship can be contrasted.
Ordered circling maintains relation to a center while the worshipper moves.
Upright standing supplies bodily stability without requiring immobility in every phase.
Inclination away from a direction supplies the unstable edge-position that the centered rites counter.
Turning something onto or away from its face supplies reversal when contingent worship fails.

structural_cues: 22:11 places worship explicitly on an edge and then depicts reversal upon trial.
22:26 combines a fixed place with movement that repeatedly preserves relation to one center.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies edge, reversal, fixed place, circuit, and standing; I infer an antithetical spatial pedagogy. A live alternative is that 22:11 only judges motivation and says nothing about the House's spatial function.

changed_reading.before: The posture sequence is a neutral inventory of rites performed at a sanctuary.
changed_reading.after: The sanctuary's centered movements train durable orientation against worship that balances conditionally at an edge and flips under pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same prostration root is first distributed across beings and bodies in heaven and earth, then localized among the House's users. Human prostration at the House becomes a site-specific participation in a surah-wide cosmic submission.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies embodied lowering and submission as the House's terminal posture.
The same lowering and submission extends across the preceding cosmic enumeration and scales the local act.

structural_cues: 22:18 enumerates heavens, earth, celestial bodies, terrain, vegetation, animals, and people under one prostration predicate.
22:26 later names prostrators as beneficiaries of a prepared terrestrial center.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies same-root prostration at cosmic and House scales; I infer local participation in the larger pattern, not literal pilgrimage by every enumerated nonhuman. The alternative is simple thematic repetition without a scale relation.

changed_reading.before: Prostrators are one human user class among others at the House.
changed_reading.after: Their local bodily descent stages, at one prepared center, the submission already attributed to the wider created order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The House's undivided divine claim is paired with rejection of obstruction, equality between resident and outsider, and arrivals through distant open passes. Purification thus acquires an access function: it clears both cultic encumbrance and human gatekeeping from a shared destination.

activation_trace.role: The partnership branch makes the prohibition relevant to claims of a divided stake or co-ownership.
The House as shelter supplies a receiving place for the distributed arrivals.
Turning people away supplies the concrete access failure opposed by the House's beneficiary construction.
Equality between two parties supplies the social rule for resident and visitor.
Repeated coming turns the House's users into an arriving public rather than a settled local constituency.
The open mountain pass supplies the long-range channels feeding movement toward the center.

structural_cues: 22:25 immediately precedes the focus with obstruction and explicit equality of resident and outsider.
22:27 answers the focus with a public summons and repeated arrivals from every distant pass.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sole divine dedication, equal access, obstruction, and mass arrival; I infer that divine ownership dislodges local gatekeeping. Alternatively, access equality may be a separate legal consequence rather than semantic content of the no-partner command.

changed_reading.before: Purification protects a sacred interior for already identified worshippers.
changed_reading.after: Purification also protects an equally accessible receiving center whose users approach from outside every local ownership boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: Avoiding the contaminating admixture of idols specifies one object of cleansing, while the contrast between meat and blood not reaching God and protective God-consciousness reaching Him prevents a merely material account. The purified House supports decontaminated allegiance and intention as well as a clean site.

activation_trace.role: Removal of dirt and defect supplies the concrete cleansing operation.
Purifying self and action from the blameworthy keeps an ethical scope live within the same imperative.
A contaminant that stains and mixes supplies the surah's concrete cultic pollution image.
The worshipped image identifies rival cultic objects as one contaminating admixture.
Repeated reaching distinguishes material offerings that do not arrive from the inward orientation that does.
Placing oneself under protection supplies the inward God-conscious orientation that gives ritual its effective direction.

structural_cues: 22:30 joins avoidance of idol-filth to avoidance of false speech.
22:37 explicitly denies that sacrificial flesh or blood reaches God and contrasts them with taqwa.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies idol-filth, a material/nonmaterial reaching contrast, and two purification branches; I infer cultic and ethical decontamination under one House command. The alternative restricts 22:26 to the sanctuary's physical state and treats later inward demands only as pilgrim conduct.

changed_reading.before: Purifying the House means removing visible dirt or forbidden objects.
changed_reading.after: Purifying the House means guarding a whole ritual ecology from rival objects, contaminating admixture, false performance, and materially reductive devotion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated q-w-m forms describe people who establish prayer under ordinary hardship, communal power, and the final Abrahamic charge. The later anti-images of an emptied settlement and disabled well show what architecture without sustained right use becomes. Together they strengthen the custodial shade of the focus's standers.

activation_trace.role: Care, preservation, and charge supply the baseline possibility that standers also sustain worship.
Keeping prayer established turns root-level standing into durable religious maintenance.
Establishing prayer when empowered scales maintenance from individual posture to public institution.
Emptiness supplies the negative image of a built place deprived of living, ordered use.
Vacancy and disabling supply the anti-function of an untended communal resource.
The closing imperative to establish prayer confirms maintenance as the community's ongoing assignment.

structural_cues: The same root recurs in forms meaning keep or establish prayer at 22:35, 22:41, and 22:78.
22:45 juxtaposes an emptied settlement, an abandoned well, and an imposing palace.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies derivational q-w-m repetition and anti-images of nonuse; I infer that some force of sustaining worship feeds back into القائمين. The live alternative is that the focus participle remains posture-only despite the surah-wide root development.

changed_reading.before: Those standing are momentary occupants of one bodily posture.
changed_reading.after: Those standing also emerge as a community that keeps prayer and its hospitable center standing across time, power, and the risk of institutional vacancy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The singular divine claim over My House is later placed within a counterfactual defense of multiple named worship buildings where God's name is voiced. Exclusive devotion and architectural plurality are not collapsed: the Abrahamic House is one concentrated center within a protected ecology of remembrance.

activation_trace.role: The sacred dwelling supplies the focus's particular built center.
Undivided devotion fixes the theological criterion without itself requiring architectural singularity.
Demolition and collapse supply the threatened fate shared by the enumerated worship buildings.
A place of prostration links built worship space back to the House's prostrating beneficiaries.
Voicing remembrance on the tongue supplies the common protected function across the plural sites.

structural_cues: 22:40 places monasteries, churches, synagogues or prayers, and mosques in one anti-demolition sequence.
The stated common feature is abundant mention of God's name.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a particular House and a defended plurality of remembrance sites; I infer an ecology in which the House exemplifies concentrated sacred service rather than monopolizing all protected architecture. Alternatively, 22:40 may only justify defense without reframing 22:26.

changed_reading.before: The command establishes an isolated sacred building whose exclusivity mirrors exclusive devotion.
changed_reading.after: The command establishes a uniquely claimed center whose function remains legible inside a wider, divinely defended plurality of places of remembrance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's unrestricted anything is echoed in a miniature agency test: invoked rivals cannot create a fly or recover even a thing taken from them. The no-partner command becomes a refusal to assign divine co-agency where the smallest demonstrated act of making and recovery fails.

activation_trace.role: The divine-partner sense supplies the claim tested by the later parable.
The unrestricted knowable thing gives the prohibition maximal scope.
Origination supplies the first concrete capability that the invoked rivals fail.
The exact generic object root compresses the test from any possible partner to even one stolen item.
Failure to extract a thing from another's hold supplies the second failed capability.
Lack of strength diagnoses both seeker and sought in the rival-agency transaction.

structural_cues: 22:73 repeats the focus's ش ي ء root inside a parable about those invoked apart from God.
The parable tests both creative power and power to retrieve a minimal loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact thing echo and failed creation and recovery; I infer that the parable operationalizes the focus's ban on divine co-agency. Alternatively, the parable attacks invoked idols generally without specifically explaining the focus's indefinite object.

changed_reading.before: Do not associate anything is an absolute allegiance rule stated without an internal test.
changed_reading.after: The rule is later stress-tested at the scale of one fly and one recoverable thing: no proposed co-agent can perform even the minimal work its claim would require.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending directly commands believers to bow and prostrate, names Abraham as their father and his way as followed, then commissions witness and established prayer. The focus's charge to one ancestor therefore opens into an inherited communal office: embody the rites, keep them established, and make them publicly witness-bearing.

activation_trace.role: The original prepared lodging supplies Abraham's founding commission.
Bowing supplies one beneficiary posture later addressed directly to the believing audience.
Prostration supplies the second posture revoiced as a closing imperative.
The command to bow turns a future House-user label into the audience's present action.
The command to prostrate completes the direct uptake of the focus's paired postures.
Selection and drawing near supply the community's commissioning for the inherited work.
A followed religious way supplies continuity rather than mere biological recollection.
Fatherhood and formation make Abraham's founding role genealogically and pedagogically active.
Knowledge-bearing testimony supplies the outward public function of the inherited practice.
Establishing and maintaining prayer turns inherited posture into durable communal order.

structural_cues: 22:77 repeats the focus's bowing and prostration roots as direct imperatives to believers.
22:78 names Abraham as father, invokes his followed way, commissions witness, and commands establishment of prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact posture repetition, Abrahamic lineage, selection, witness, and established prayer; I infer continuity of commission from founder to community. A live alternative is that fatherhood marks religious ancestry without transferring any House-specific office.

changed_reading.before: Abraham prepares the House for an unspecified later population of worshippers.
changed_reading.after: The surah's final audience recognizes itself as that Abrahamic population, inheriting the work through enacted posture, sustained prayer, and witness before humanity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the hunter's-snare branch of ش ر ك rather than treating it as the focus's direct lexical gloss. It remains anchored by the same root, the focus's free circling around a center, and 22:31's same-root fall, seizure, and remote displacement. Downstream prose should present it only as a spatial metaphorical echo, not as a replacement translation of لا تشرك.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes لا تشرك with unobstructed circling around a prepared center.

activation_trace.role: A hunter's entangling device supplies a deliberately branch-distant image for compromised allegiance.
Free ordered circling supplies the movement that entanglement would derail.
The repeated association root keeps the snare image attached to the surah's explicit anti-association simile.
Swift seizure supplies the loss of controlled movement after centered relation breaks.
Falling into an abyss supplies uncontrolled vertical movement opposite the focus's ordered lowering.
Extreme distance supplies displacement away from the prepared center.

changed_reading.before: Association is only the propositional act of naming a divine partner.
changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial echo, association behaves like entanglement that converts centered circulation and voluntary lowering into seizure, fall, and dispersal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain analogy between sanctuary cleansing and the later removal of an intrusive casting from prophetic communication. It remains anchored in طهر, the undivided House, and the packet's explicit remove-then-secure process, but 22:52 does not identify revelation with architecture. Downstream prose should qualify it as a process analogy about protected containers, never as a claim that the verses share one literal referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: طهر بيتي commands removal of what compromises a divinely claimed receiving space.

activation_trace.role: Removal of contaminant supplies the focus-side filtering operation.
The dwelling supplies a bounded receiving environment whose intended use can be protected.
Casting something in supplies the intrusive input in the comparison.
Removal followed by replacement supplies an explicit filtering step.
Making firm and secure supplies the stabilized state after removal.

changed_reading.before: House purification is only cleaning a physical sanctuary.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified process analogy, it is also protection of a commissioned container: foreign insertion is removed so the intended divine ordering remains firm.

strongest_changes: The House's sole divine claim becomes the ground for equal human access rather than local possession.
Purification expands from visible cleanliness to cultic and ethical decontamination without dissolving its material sense.
The standers become plausible maintainers who keep prayer and the House's use established against vacancy.
The closing bowing, prostration, Abrahamic fatherhood, witness, and established prayer turn the founding commission into an inherited communal office.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the focus operate simultaneously as centered movement, public access institution, protected worship site, and Abrahamic witness-training commission; distant same-root returns changed several apparently static nouns and postures into durable social functions.
remaining_uncertainties: The custodial force in القائمين is strongly activated by later q-w-m forms but remains secondary to the immediate postural syntax.
The link from exclusive divine ownership to equal human access is a reader-supplied legal-social arrow, not an explicit causal statement in 22:26.
The snare and filtered-container outliers are useful only under explicit metaphorical and cross-domain containment.
